summary: 红队打出真实重击:资产负债表衰退机制成立、2023年已现通缩、抵消项兑现高度依赖尚未发生的政策转向;但三者均为条件性/可被强力财政与结构改革干预的风险,而非注定结局。红队证明『停滞风险严肃』,未能证明『停滞必然』。

evidence.title: DOC-0003
evidence.quote: China has a balance sheet problem, probably smaller than Japan's, but you have a big construction problem, and the two together could be quite challenging.

evidence.title: DOC-0004
evidence.quote: China recently slipped into deflation for the first time in two years due to weak domestic demand and a housing slump.

open_questions: 政策是否及时转向消费与改革,决定红队风险是否落地
